verdicts.rationale: These are identical concepts representing the Breusch-Pagan test for heteroskedasticity.
The White test can be seen as a broader alternative to the Breusch-Pagan test because it does not assume normality and detects more general forms of heteroskedasticity.
When the Breusch-Pagan test detects heteroskedasticity, you use heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors to fix your inference.
The Breusch-Pagan test is specifically designed to detect the presence of heteroskedasticity in your regression model.
